config.stealthpipe.title: StealthPipe Configuration
config.stealthpipe.relayAddress.descript:
Specifies where StealthPipe should try to relay the data to.

§6Remove the leading slash, and include https:// or http:// in the URL.
config.stealthpipe.onlineMode.descriptio:
Equivalent to the 'online-mode' option in server.properties.
Controls whether Minecraft contacts Mojang servers to authenticate incoming players.
Disable this if you are experiencing 'Invalid session' errors.
config.stealthpipe.connectionAttempts.de: Controls how many attempts are made to reach the relay before giving up.
config.stealthpipe.webrtcClientEnabled.d:
Controls whether the client attempts a WebRTC peer-to-peer connection
to the host for faster connections and lower latency.

§7If disabled, StealthPipe will fall back to WebSockets instead.
§6WebRTC requires sharing your IP address with the host and may expose your
real IP address even when using a VPN.
§bTo reject WebRTC connection attempts as the host, disable
'Host Allow WebRTC' instead.
config.stealthpipe.webrtcHostEnabled.des:
Controls whether to allow WebRTC connections as the host.

§7If disabled, all clients connecting to your room will fall back
to using WebSockets instead.
§6WebRTC requires sharing your IP address with all clients and may
expose your real IP address even when using a VPN.
§bTo prevent WebRTC connection attempts on the client side, disable
'Client Attempt WebRTC' instead.
config.stealthpipe.showConnectingInfo.de:
Controls whether to show connection progress
at the top of the screen.

§7Disable this if the overlay gets stuck on the
screen or conflicts with the game.
config.stealthpipe.packetBatching.descri:
Controls whether packets sent at roughly the same interval are grouped
to increase connection reliability and reduce load on the relay.

Can reduce packet count by approximately 6–10×.

Although rare in StealthPipe V6+, this may slightly increase latency.
config.stealthpipe.packetBatchingInterva:
Controls the packet batching interval.

Higher values group more packets together, reducing overhead but increasing latency.
Lower values group fewer packets together, increasing overhead but reducing latency.
config.stealthpipe.wrtcIceFailure.descri:
Simulates ICE candidates failure.

§6You should never enable this option unless you are a developer.
config.stealthpipe.logIceCandidates.desc:
Whether or not to log all the info going through WebRTC signaling. Only enable this to report an issue, and always send logs privately with this option enabled.

§6Enabling this will reveal sensitive info such as IP addresses and network topology!
config.stealthpipe.abnormalDisconnectCli: Simulates an abnormal disconnect as a client only
config.stealthpipe.abnormalDisconnectHos: Simulates an abnormal disconnect as a host only
config.stealthpipe.failureDelay.descript: Number of seconds before initiating simulated failure
config.stealthpipe.latencySpikes.descrip: Simulates huge latency spikes (of 1 second) to aid in finding RACE conditions.
config.stealthpipe.latencySpikesDirectio: Controls which direction the latency will spike in.
config.stealthpipe.latencyBaseline.descr: Controls the baseline latency for debugging
config.stealthpipe.safeInject.descriptio:
Uses the channel's event loop to safely inject a packet.
May increase latency.
config.stealthpipe.warnCorruptedData.des: If enabled, data corruption warnings will be shown in Chat.
config.stealthpipe.parkCpu.description:
Parks the CPU instead of using a busy loop, significantly
reducing CPU usage at the cost of slightly higher latency
and reduced precision in the packet batching loop.

Disable this if you want potentially lower latency.
config.stealthpipe.threadPriority.descri:
Controls the thread priority of the packet batching loop.

Higher values = higher thread priority = potentially lower latency.
Lower values = lower thread priority = potentially higher latency.

§6Warning: Setting the thread priority to maximum (10) while disabling
'Park CPU' may cause extreme lag.
